title: Runtime — SMP & Operator Overview
description: OPERATIONAL_CONTRACT: What is the SMP queue depth by priority, message age, and enqueue throughput? | METRICS_DEPENDENCY: [smp_queue_depth{priority}, smp_oldest_pending_seconds{priority}, smp_enqueue_total{outcome}] | METRICS_SOURCE: ThreadForge SMP runtime instrumentation | BREAKS_IF: SMP service down OR metrics no longer emitted OR Prometheus scrape fails | OWNER: SMP / Runtime SRE | Last validated: 2026-02-09

panels.title: SMP Queue Depth (Total)

panels.title: Queue Depth by Priority
panels.description: PANEL_CONTRACT: Queue depth by priority | METRIC: smp_queue_depth | NOTE: No data = exporter missing

panels.title: Oldest Message Age by Priority (seconds)
panels.description: PANEL_CONTRACT: Oldest pending message age by priority | METRIC: smp_oldest_pending_seconds | NOTE: No data = exporter missing

panels.title: SMP Enqueue Rate (by outcome)
panels.description: PANEL_CONTRACT: SMP enqueue rate by outcome | METRIC: rate(smp_enqueue_total[1m]) | NOTE: No data = exporter missing

panels.title: Operator Pressure Signal Active

panels.title: System Health Summary
panels.description: PANEL_CONTRACT: Operator health quick check | METRIC: sum(smp_queue_depth) < 25 | NOTE: False indicates sustained pressure
